column2: chrom_arms_grch38.tsv -- GRCh38 chromosome arm boundaries for arm-level CNV event calling.
SOURCE: UCSC hg38 cytoBand, the two flanking "acen" bands per chromosome (cen_start = start of
the p-side acen band, cen_end = end of the q-side acen band). chrom_len = UCSC hg38 chromInfo.
Genome build is confirmed by the data: inferCNV chr17 regions run to 83,051,810 vs
GRCh38 chr17 = 83,257,441 (hg19 chr17 = 81,195,210), so the runs are GRCh38.
acrocentric = TRUE -> the p arm carries no assayable genes; excluded via LCC_ARMS_EXCLUDE.
